Interactive table of peptides, linked to the volcano/fissure_vent/Woods plots

Source: R/interactive_explorer.R
significant_peptides_table.Rd

DT::datatable() of every peptide in the comparison (sortable/searchable), with a significant column from the same hybrid criterion as the other interactive plots. Selecting rows highlights the corresponding peptides on any other plot built from the same shared_data.

Usage

significant_peptides_table(
  df,
  state1,
  state2,
  times,
  replicates = 3,
  alpha = 0.01,
  pvalue = 0.01,
  shared_data = NULL,
  p_adjust = "none"
)

Arguments

df

output of output_tp().

state1

First protein state, matched as in plot_fissure_vent(). Defaults to the first state found in df.

state2

Second protein state. Defaults to the second state found.

times

a single Deut.Time value to plot.

replicates

number of replicates. Default 3.

alpha

alpha for the pooled critical interval. Default 0.01. May be a vector (paired element-wise with pvalue, recycled to a common length) - with more than one combination, the plot gets a dropdown (native plotly updatemenus, no R session needed) that swaps between the pre-computed colorings/thresholds for each alpha/pvalue pair. Peptide positions never move (delta and p-value don't depend on either parameter) - only which points/lines count as significant.

pvalue

per-peptide significance cutoff. Default 0.01. See alpha for vector/dropdown behavior.

shared_data

optional crosstalk::SharedData object (as built internally by interactive_fissure_explorer()) so this plot's selection is linked to other plots sharing the same object. If NULL (default), a new one is built and this plot works standalone. The linked key (which peptide is which) always follows shared_data; only the significance coloring/dropdown below is local to this plot.

p_adjust

multiple-testing correction of the per-peptide Welch p-values, passed to stats::p.adjust(): "none" (default) or e.g. "BH", applied across the peptides of the comparison.

Value

a DT::datatable htmlwidget.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("crosstalk", quietly = TRUE)
    && requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)) {
file_nm <- system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
a <- output_tp(file_nm)
significant_peptides_table(a, state1 = "Unbound", state2 = "bound", times = "1800.00s")
}
#> Protein.States used: Unbound bound
#> Deut.times used: 3.00s 60.00s 1800.00s 72000.00s
#> 29 peptide row(s) dropped: 29 not measured in every state, 0 with fewer than 2 replicate value(s)
#> Number of replicates used: Unbound=3 bound=3
#> no csv file written
